182000.description:
Ujin Kang is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he’s pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character’s experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generation acting prodigy, Ujin is suddenly thrust into a world of media and celebrities far beyond his quiet, insignificant life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

182001.description:
“Fate, save my unborn child…!” These are the last words of Princess Hinael as she plummets to her death at the hands of Count Chetaire, her unfaithful husband. Little does Hinael know that destiny will grant her a second chance, as she awakens two years in the past, shortly before her marriage. With her knowledge of what’s to come, Hinael attempts to rewrite the stars for herself and her future child. And what better way to achieve her ambitions than to court her kingdom’s former enemy, the dark and stern Prince Lutz of the Empire of Triekas?

(Source: WEBTOON)

182002.description:
Na-Jin’s mother arranges a date for her with someone Na-Jin’s best friend describes as “nuclear trash.” When she arrives to meet nuclear-trash-man Joo-Hyuk for that date, she comes face-to-face with her reckless one-night stand from the night before. He’s ready to disprove her misconceptions and eager to jump into marriage to make both of their mothers happy. He likes her; she needs him. That’s enough, right? Will she find happiness, or is she doomed to live out this charade to please others?

(source: Tapas)

182003.description:
Ever since the discovery that she was not the emperor's real daughter, Daphne has lived a lonely life as a maid at the imperial palace. Amidst the daily bullying and mockery she suffers from others, her sole solace is Asherad, the Crown Prince. He is the only one who treats her with warmth, and she can't help but fall for his kindness. However, Asherad's kindness is merely a cloak for his cruelty and possessiveness. When Daphne discovers his true nature, she resolves to leave his side… But will she be able to outrun Asherad's obsession with her?

That is, until she dies and finds herself reincarnated into the novel as Eloise, Ian's first wife! At first, it seems like the worst possible fate, but what if this is an opportunity? If Eloise can mold Ian into the ideal husband for her beloved Diana, she can give her the perfect ending. Unfortunately, she finds that it may be harder than she thinks...

(Source: Tapas)

The Las Lilte Empire, with boundless magic power at their command, has grown to great prosperity…but in the wrong hands, that power can pose a grave threat. To counteract the rampant abuse of magic, the Empire established the Magic Crimes Bureau. In the imperial capital, Elayl, hardened detective Rogue has to make a deal with the most despicable criminal of them all—because only Miseria, the witch who unleashed hell on the world, has the kind of power that can help him solve the case surrounding the Lifetaker. But when you’re dealing with convicted witches, standard investigation protocol just won’t cut it…

At Hertiar Academy, exclusive to the elite, Jeremy, the troubled heir of the Hertiar family, becomes dangerously fixated on Lucian. Consumed by jealousy, Jeremy openly displays affection for Lucian in front of Daniel, trying to drive a wedge between them. One who can have everything except the one he wants. That is until she sees him working in a butcher shop! Is the man Do-A fell for not who she thought he was?

Up-and-coming actor Seo Gang-U is up for "Rookie of the Year" when his former lover, industry exec Lee Ji-Won, suggests they act like a couple in public. Although they are no longer dating, Ji-Won now needs Gang-U's help to create a dating scandal that will break off an engagement set up by her family. With his lingering affection for Ji-Won, Gang-U jumps at this chance to be close to her again. Although it's all supposed to be acting, will Gang-U's real feelings for Ji-Won blow everything?

Convinced of the Duke's guilt, she juggles evading the main storyline while also uncovering the truth. With her virtual lives dwindling, can Arviche game her way out, or is a game-over fate sealed?

But Yoonwoo's incarceration takes a surprising turn when none other than the man who put him up to this whole thing shows up in handcuffs. Just how will Yoonwoo make it through his sentence with such an unlikely cast of inmates, no alpha by his side, and a baby on the way?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world of angels and demons, Kang Yise was granted immortality and has lived for centuries. He now runs a detective agency under a pseudonym and helps people find information. One day, a fallen angel named Kwak Rowan comes to him as a client. And much to Yise's surprise, Rowan asks him to find the whereabouts of Kang Yise so he can eliminate the latter! Despite not being able to die, Yise is still baffled by Rowan's desire to kill him. Can he hide his identity long enough to find out why?

(Source: Tapas)

182026.description:
In the bustling royal palace, Erica, reborn into nobility with a passion for tea-brewing from her past life, finds her future steeped in drama. Her exceptional tea-making skills quickly catch the court's attention. Navigating the tricky politics of tea time, Erica must charm the demanding Crown Prince with her unique blends. Each cup she crafts could bring her closer to her dream of opening a teahouse in the capital or spell disaster. Join Erica in a delightful mix of comedy, romance, and royal intrigue, where every brew has the power to shape her destiny and uncover secrets.

The moment Ylledia meets Dennis, a glimmer of hope for the world is rekindled within her. Could this boy be the key to saving the world? When Lee Chae-Rin kicks the bucket, she’s whisked into a dark fantasy novel as Rose Estania, a chambermaid at the mercy of the tyrant crown prince, Kalix Forsman. Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late?

Waking up in a fairy tale she illustrated, Hazel is rumored to be a wicked, man-eating witch. In truth, all she wants to do is bake sweets and share the kindness. So when the adorable Luna and Luca show up at the door of her gingerbread house, Hazel is determined to care for the siblings. However, things go awry when their guardian and brother, Grand Duke Elliot Blaine, show up, accusing her of kidnapping them. Now, with her charm and cooking skills, Hazel must prove she is indeed a sweet witch!

A story about 'acquaintances' who are neither too close nor too far away.

182042.description:
What would you do when you've transmigrated as the most-hated villainess in the story? In the case of Marso, she tried hard to change the storyline by performing good deeds and taking care of the female lead. However, things are not going as she had hoped for—every character in the story still hates her! It seems no matter what she does she cannot seem to change her fate. Tired of trying, Marso declares that she'll stay home and do nothing—for the rest of her life.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Yeon-U Chae, a talented yet lonely composer from Korea, finds herself and her family trapped in the underworld after a car crash. In her first life, she marries Hyo-Jo, who ultimately kills her. In her second life, she takes revenge by taking her own life in front of him. But despite her desperate wish for an end, she’s given another chance at life. However, this time, instead of encountering Hyo-Jo, she is discovered by Hwi-Ta, a mysterious man with a black wolf as his guardian spirit. Can Yeon-U break the cycle and find true safety in this treacherous underworld?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

(Source: Arechi Manga)

182046.description:
An immortal high school student, So-Yeong is secretly crushing on human golden retriever Hui-Jae. Mysteriously, he keeps coming into near-death danger and So-Yeong repeatedly sacrifices herself to protect him. Something begins to grow between the two, and someone doesn't like that. What will happen to their lives and fate?!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182047.description:
On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.

(Source: WEBTOON)

182048.description:
Timid orphan Violet discovers she's the empire's new saint destined to destroy the evil Malum. Unfortunately, she's surrounded by scornful nobles and the power-hungry emperor and pope. Alone, friendless, and overwhelmed, she finds solace in Ethelmund, heir of House Ermengart, who vows to protect her until the end. Can this fragile wildflower find her footing in the thorny and dangerous world of politics and betrayal? And will she be able to fulfill her destiny with only Ethelmund by her side?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Violets Blooming in the Back Garden

title.english: The Blooming Violet in the Back Garden

3rd-generation Korean-American Brenda falls in love with Jeju Island while researching its female divers. She decides to take the plunge and move to the island with her husband. There, she dives deep into Jeju's history and culture while healing, growing, and building friendships along the way.

(Source: Manta)

Hyeon-U makes a living busking in subway stations. Turns out being blind makes people a lot more generous — and a lot more confiding. But when a strange man approaches him with a secret of his own, Hyeon-U is suddenly entangled in a murder case, turning his life upside down.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Sophia Riller, sixteen years old, was about to attend the Blessing Ceremony--a ritual in which a boy or girl of sixteen years is gifted with abilities from one of the various animal gods. A blessing from one of the bird gods could grant wings that allow one to soar through the skies. The boons are many and varied. Sophia, a clumsy type, was hoping that she would be chosen by a god that doesn't stand out...but...it was the Gorilla God who chose her! She was told that those blessed by the Gorilla God will have a gift for combat and needs to take the exam to become a Junior Knight. On the exam day, she met Louis, a handsome knight-to-be and two boys, who soon found out who Sophia was blessed by. Her life changes completely from that day...

On a cold, rainy day, Suu, a carnivore, stumbles upon two tiny furballs abandoned in the storm. The twins, Shaoru and Miku, are gentle herbivores without claws or fangs and don’t eat meat. Determined not to frighten them, Suu embraces a herbivorous lifestyle. As time passes, Shaoru and Miku grow taller than Suu and feel compelled to protect their guardian, who has lost much of his predator-like edge. title.english: You're My Pet as of Today

182136.description:
Xia Yang is a college student that's a sucker for people with good looking faces and has been a fan of the idol, Jiang Zhengze, for many years. He is obsessed with idols, crazy about idols, and would do anything for his idols. But one day, the idol he longed for turned into a demon who wants to eat him up, constantly pushing him to the edge of his sanity. Thus his agonizing and turbulent cohabitation life begins...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

182138.description: Ryouichi Aruji has a live-in maid named Maguro-san working at his home. Maguro-san may be absolutely flawless when it comes to her duties as a maid, but her sense of personal boundaries seems to be completely broken, and she has no problem firing off one dirty joke after another!
synonyms: The Jet-Black Maid Is Ridiculously Lewd

title.native: マグロメイドがしこたまえっち!

182139.description:
Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move -- he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: All My Alter Egos Are Tycoons
My Alter Ego's Path to Greatness

182160.description:
Amidst a zombie apocalypse, Vin Yeom, an exterminator, finds a new purpose as an undertaker, specializing in funerals for the infected. Within the walls of the quarantine zone, he and his team navigate a treacherous world, providing solace to grieving families. Their company offers a unique but costly service that bridges the gap between life and death, allowing for one last goodbye. But in this world of death and despair, secrets linger, and the very loss that led Vin down this path may unearth a conspiracy that will shock the world and perhaps... help him find his way back.

(Source: WEBTOON)

182164.description:
Marin, a caretaker from the Dream Management Bureau, works with Bakuo, a Dream Tapir, to turn young girls' nightmares into sweet dreams. Perhaps they'll come to visit you at your pillow tonight...? A heartwarming dreamy fantasy!

(source: Kodansha, translated)

182166.description:
You ask anxiously, "Is it okay if I’m the one?"

It’s precisely because of that side of you that I want to stay by your side.

Fukusuke, a nice but plain guy, falls in love at first sight with the most beautiful girl in class, Yua. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend, the basketball ace, Yuusei. He sighs at the thought of an unrequited love.

One day, Fukusuke discovers another super cute girl hiding in Yua's shadow, Usuba Amari, who doesn’t stand out.

“Um, w-would you be my friend?”

He starts practicing to “become normal” with the shy girl, but—

“Amari-chan, the one you admire is Yuusei, right?”

“...”

“W-Why is your face so red?”

A love comedy unfolds as Fukusuke begins a friendship with the hidden beauty that only he knows.
synonyms: I Found Amari-chan Next to the Number One Girl I Wanted to Make My Girlfriend

182177.description:
Song Joo-hee, who is unable to live her own life because she is busy paying off her family's debt, coincidentally meets Kang Se-ra, a rich girl who ran away from home, and they spend a night together. She is so charmed by her that she accepts her offer to live together...

(Source: Naver, translated)

182178.description:
A mystery hangs over the remote island of Manwol. The locals have all perished after being turned into monsters in an experiment by the imperial army. But Geumran, a young deaf girl, inexplicably survives, recovering her hearing and gaining incredible strength. Though she kills all of the soldiers in cold blood, Geumran soon learns that the same fate that befell the villagers awaits her too. Finding those responsible for the experiments thus becomes her only hope for survival... and vengeance.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes:
- A spin-off webtoon of the Netflix original series “Gyeongseong Creature”. The worldview is the same, but the story and background are different.
- Chapter count includes Chapter 0.
synonyms: Gyeongseong Creature Side Story: A Flower That Never Fades

182179.description:
Under the rule of the Solitary King Wilfred, who purged his own brother to enforce his reforms, Princess Alicia from a neighboring country was wed to him in a political marriage.

"Your Majesty, you're actually quite a kind person, aren't you?"

"...What?"

While everyone feared and revered him, Alicia, who was raised as a commoner for certain reasons, closed the distance with her natural cheerfulness and friendliness. As she rejoiced, laughed, and even got angry for his sake, Wilfred gradually opened his heart to her—

And now, the life of the happiest couple is about to begin!
synonyms: Until the Solitary King and the Sunshine Bride Become the Happiest Couple
The Lonely King and His Sunshine Bride’s Happily Ever After

title.native: 孤高の王と陽だまりの花嫁が最幸の夫婦になるまで

182183.description:
Hiyakawa-san’s handsome but perpetually frowning face strikes fear into the hearts of his co-workers. But around Tetsuhara Miori, his façade slips—often getting clumsy, careless, and blurting out his true thoughts. Now she’s dealing with a mumbling, bumbling, blushing boss! Awkward and sweet days unfold when you have a boss this flustered in this workplace romantic comedy!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Story about My Boss Who Only Gets Flustered with Me
Watashi ni dake Temparu Joushi no Hanashi

title.english: My Boss Only Gets Flustered Around Me
title.native: 私にだけテンパる上司の話
title.romaji: Watashi ni dake Tenparu Joushi no Hanashi

182184.description:
Ahjin is a crippled boy doing house chores under insomniac gang boss Seokju. Unexpectedly, they make two damaged sides of a good pair. Unfortunately, fate has other ideas for them, and as their lives spiral downwards, one question remains: are they damned to this destiny, or can they find a happy ending?

(Source: Lezhin US)

182185.description:
Seong-Ha seeks a big man to fulfill his desires. At a freshman retreat, he meets Mu-Beom — a big guy with glasses that make his eyes tiny. Impervious to seduction and a total square, Mu-Beom puzzles Seong-Ha. Seong-Ha hates alphas, and Mu-Beom has a thing for pheromones. How will this odd pair turn out?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 異世界召喚されたけど、俺はいらないらしいので、美少女ちゃんたち引き連れて、異世界と日本で楽しく過ごします。
title.romaji: Isekai Shoukan Sareta kedo, Ore wa Iranairashii node, Bishoujo-chan-tachi Hikitsurete, Isekai to Nihon de Tanoshiku Sugoshimasu.

182187.description:
People in this world are born with “skills” and “jobs." Our main character, Heat, has the unique skill of “invulnerability,” but his job was “the weakest commoner,” which does not grow in strength even with experience. Born with such a seemingly useless job, he is about to be fired from his adventuring party. However, Nuun, the A-ranked wizard was suppose to replace him, objects to this change…?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)
synonyms: Fujimi no Chikara ga Tsuyoi no wa, Mugen ni Doryoku wo Dekiru kara
不死身の力が強いのは、無限に努力をできるから

title.native: 追放された最弱庶民の成り上がりハーレム！ 『不死身』のスキルで最強をめざし、見下したやつにざまぁします！
title.romaji: Tsuihou sareta Saijaku Shomin no Nariagari Harem!: “Fujimi” no Skill de Saikyou wo Mezashi, Mikudashita Yatsu ni Zamaa Shimasu!

182188.description:
A succubus has granted me a second chance at life. Each time I sleep with a new girl, she tells me a crucial future event that could change my fate.

(Source: Toomics)
